# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the current `main` branch. Pre-release tags and
older snapshots are not maintained as separate supported release lines.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Use GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/frknuynk/seismic-atlas/security/advisories/new)
to share:

- the affected route, component, or commit;
- clear reproduction steps or a minimal proof of concept;
- the expected impact;
- any suggested mitigation, if available.

You should receive an acknowledgement within seven days. The maintainer will
validate the report, coordinate a fix and disclosure when appropriate, and
credit the reporter unless anonymity is requested.

Please avoid accessing data that is not yours, disrupting AFAD or other
upstream services, or testing against a public deployment in a way that creates
load or affects other users.
